scope: Targeted immediate notification/Session reference abstraction,not implementation refinement or whole Session/data proof

source_mapping.Publish: sle_native.rs ACB/NOCP after Host/data/gate unlock -> sle_sessions.rs kick_session_data Release flag + existing Runtime schedule_rx(0)
source_mapping.RuntimeBegin/RuntimeFinish: sle_workers.rs WorkItem<0> existing serialized workqueue;queue-while-running semantics assumed from mod_delayed_work RawWorkItem contract,not verified by this model
source_mapping.TakeReference: same function Session table Mutex;get distinct kref for unstopped object;table lock released before callback
source_mapping.Notify: sle_channel_socket.c sl_connection_session_kick Session spinlock,active check,mod_delayed_work(...,0),queue kref settlement
source_mapping.PutReference: sle_sessions.rs sl_connection_session_put for each collected target after C kick
source_mapping.SessionBegin/SessionFinish: sle_channel_socket.c sl_work serialized callback,state recheck and final kref put;observed means worker recheck,not packet consumption/delivery
source_mapping.Close/Cancel/DropTable: sl_connection_session_stop closes under Session lock,cancel_delayed_work_sync outside locks;reconcile/stop_sessions table removal/drop after required join

assumptions: Actual Linux workqueue/kref/lock API behavior is trusted here;model does not verify their implementation or memory reclamation.
Weak fairness for enabled Runtime stages and Session worker/cancel/table-drop actions;no fairness imposed on Publish or Close,no bounded scheduling latency guarantee.
One physical Session/lifetime per controller,already authorized/registered;no grant creation,identity reuse,protocol credit,USB or hardware model.
Session retirement closes admission before cancel/join andtable owner drop;actual callback/drain correctness still needs VM/concurrency/refinement evidence.
Periodic10ms Session and500ms Runtime fallback deliberately excluded tocheck immediate chain independently;model isnot complete scheduling implementation.
Epoch is an abstract bounded notification version;observed is state recheck,not application delivery or NOCP truth.
